scripts.dev: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run dev -w @portal/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run build -w @portal/api && npm run build -w @portal/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tests/e2e
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && eslint apps/api packages/contracts apps/web tests/e2e
scripts.test: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run test -w @portal/contracts && npm run test -w @portal/api && npm run test -w @portal/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @portal/contracts && npm run dev -w @portal/web
